spec_family.name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Prime and Paint
spec_family.description: Combined prime and finish for porch/veranda ceiling (overhead). Key differences from soffit: spray always eligible (no attic vent concern), no vinyl substrate, beadboard panel type added. Overhead work penalty (~25-35% from vertical baselines) baked into all rates. Sheltered surface with higher mildew risk. Flat to satin sheen only.

includes: Porch/veranda ceiling field painting — all overhead ceiling surfaces
Surface preparation (low-pressure wash, substrate-specific sanding, dust cleanup)
T&G and beadboard groove work (brush detail for groove joints)
End-seal fiber cement cut edges (RISK-PRCH-004 prevention)
Tannin spot-prime knots on wood ceiling (cedar/redwood)
Caulk panel joints and ceiling-to-fascia/wall junctions
Full field prime coat (3 substrate-driven primer paths)
Finish coat application (1-2 coats by quality tier)
Cut-in at fascia, wall, and column junctions
Porch floor protection (critical for overhead drip fallout)
Ceiling-mounted fixture masking (ceiling fans, pendant lights, recessed cans)

excludes.route_to: SF_SOFFIT_EXT_NC — separate scope for enclosed eave soffit
Future SF_PORCH_FLOOR_EXT_NC or out of scope

excludes.item: House wall painting at porch attachment

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling coat count, inspection scrutiny, interstage sanding, and defect tolerance.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2=economy (single finish coat). QT3=standard (2 coats). QT4=premium (2 coats, interstage sand, systematic inspection). QT5 excluded — porch ceiling is a field surface, not fine millwork.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique. Both always eligible — no vent type constraint.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Both methods ALWAYS eligible on porch ceiling (no attic vent concern, unlike soffit). spray_backroll NOT valid — overhead back-rolling is impractical.
Wood: T&G boards, beadboard panels, plywood. Fiber cement: HardieSoffit-style panels. No vinyl substrate.
Overhead surfaces use flat or satin only. Flat is most common porch ceiling sheen.

configuration_dimensions.description: Ceiling panel/board construction type. Drives joint complexity modifier.
configuration_dimensions.notes: T&G and beadboard both have 20% higher labor (FAC_PRCH_PANEL_JOINTS). Solid panel has no joint penalty.

paintable_items.name: Exterior porch ceiling field surface
paintable_items.counting_rules: Net paintable porch ceiling area in square feet. Porch width x porch length. Excludes fixture openings.
paintable_items.notes: Single paintable item — covers wood and fiber cement. SF-based.

valid_input_states.notes: SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD: bare wood T&G, beadboard, or plywood. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY: fiber cement with factory primer. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD: already field-primed — skip prime module.

material_systems.name: Exterior Acrylic Primer for Wood/FC Porch Ceiling
material_systems.notes: 100% acrylic exterior primer for bare wood and factory-primed FC.

material_systems.name: Alkyd/Shellac Spot Primer for Tannin Knots
material_systems.notes: Spot-applied to knots on cedar/redwood. Prevents tannin bleed.

material_systems.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer for Bare FC Porch Ceiling
material_systems.notes: Required for bare/damaged FC (pH 13.0). Prevents saponification.

material_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Porch Ceiling Paint
material_systems.notes: 100% acrylic with mildewcide. QT2: 1 coat. QT3: 2 coats.

material_systems.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic Porch Ceiling Paint
material_systems.notes: Premium materials. 2 coats. Intercoat sand. Mildew-resistant.

modules.name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Protection & Equipment Setup
Exterior Porch Ceiling Cleanup & Protection Teardown

production_summary.overhead_rate_design: BAKED_INTO_BASE_RATES — all rates include ~25-35% overhead penalty. FAC_PRCH_OVERHEAD NOT applied as stacking modifier.

factor_modifiers.name: Access Type Modifier
factor_modifiers.notes: Stacks on top of overhead-adjusted base rates.

factor_modifiers.name: T&G / Beadboard Joint Complexity Modifier
factor_modifiers.applies_to: Brush/roll application and wood sand prep tasks
factor_modifiers.notes: T&G and beadboard both have groove joints. Groove brush-back tasks excluded (rate already reflects groove work).

variants.notes: Economy brush/roll on bare/factory-primed. Single finish coat.
Premium brush/roll. Interstage sand. Systematic inspection.
Standard spray. Full protection for overspray.
Premium spray. Interstage sand. Systematic inspection.
Economy on field-primed. Skip prime. Single finish.
Standard on field-primed. Skip prime. Two finish coats.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Number of porch sections/elevations in scope
New construction flag. Always true for NC spec.

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: When porch floor is below ceiling work zone (always for porch ceiling)

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Count of porch furniture items to cover/remove
Count of ceiling-mounted fixtures (fans, lights, cans)

protection_zones_required.notes: CRITICAL for overhead. All drips onto porch floor. Canvas for crew traffic.
Cover with plastic or remove. Removal preferred.
Ceiling fans, pendant lights, recessed cans. Remove fan blades if possible.
Tape + film at fascia-ceiling junction when fascia is painted.
Tape at wall-ceiling junction when wall is painted.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: May be continuous with eave soffit. Often same color. Minimal edge work.
Fascia at porch roof edge. Trim color. Cut-in required.
House wall at porch attachment. Cut-in required.
Porch columns/posts. Cut-in at column-to-ceiling junction.
Below ceiling. Different material/color. No cut-in (vertical separation).

deduplication_notes: Fascia is SF_TRIM_EXT_NC scope. This spec handles ceiling side of fascia-ceiling junction.
Soffit is SF_SOFFIT_EXT_NC scope. When continuous, edge work at transition is minimal (same color typical).
Porch floor is NOT this spec — future separate scope.
Porch columns are NOT this spec — future or trim scope.
House wall at porch is siding spec scope.

round_configurations.name: Prime + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations.description: Standard NC: 1 prime + 2 finish at QT3/QT4.

round_configurations.name: 2 Finish Coats Only (Field-Primed)
round_configurations.description: Skip prime, 2 finish at QT3/QT4 on field-primed.

round_configurations.name: 1 Finish Coat Only (Economy, Field-Primed)
round_configurations.description: Economy QT2 single finish on field-primed.

issues.description: Beadboard 1.20x modifier assumed equal to T&G. Flag for field calibration.
Ceiling fan masking rate (8 EA/hr) is blended average. Complex fans may take longer.

critical_risks: RISK-PRCH-004: Edge wicking on FC panels — mitigated by edge sealing task

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup -> Prep -> Prime -> Finish 1 -> Interstage -> Finish 2 -> Final Inspect -> Cleanup
sequencing_notes.edge_work: Cut-in at fascia, wall, and column junctions. Required for both methods.
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Porch floor -> Furniture cover/removal -> Fixture masking -> Fascia/wall masking -> Equipment setup -> Coating -> Teardown -> Cleanup
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Prep -> Prime (1 coat, skip for field-primed) -> Finish 1 -> Interstage -> Finish 2 (QT3/QT4) -> Final inspect -> Touch up
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO power washing. NO semi-gloss or gloss sheen.

relationships.cross_spec_protection_note: Fascia/wall protection during ceiling work is this spec's responsibility when those surfaces are already finished.
relationships.notes: Second exterior overhead field-surface spec. Closely mirrors soffit with key simplifications: no vent constraint, no vinyl, beadboard added. 31 tasks (vs 37 soffit). 5 material systems (vs 7 soffit). Max stacking 1.92x (vs 2.208x soffit).

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for exterior porch/veranda ceiling prime and paint (new construction). Second exterior overhead field-surface spec. Combined prime+paint (single mobilization). Key features: overhead-adjusted base rates, spray ALWAYS eligible (no vent constraint unlike soffit), no vinyl substrate (3 primer paths instead of 4, 5 material systems instead of 7), beadboard panel type added (same 1.20x modifier as T&G), 5 configuration dimensions (quality_tier QT2-QT4, application_method, substrate_material wood/FC, sheen flat/satin, panel_type), 31 tasks across 8 modules (23 binary + 6 qt_scaled + 2 qt_conditional), 5 protection zones (porch floor, furniture, fixtures, fascia, wall), 2 stacking modifiers (access/panel joints, max 1.92x). QA result: pass (2 minor observations).
